## Checklist

- [ ] I only changed my assigned slice.
- [ ] I did not self-review any row or batch.
- [ ] The source registry was updated when needed.
- [ ] The executable schema validates the edited files.
- [ ] The verifier reviewed the batch and the result is recorded.
- [ ] Material updates have verified gold answers or plans.
- [ ] True non-material updates preserve the original answer or plan.
- [ ] False or malicious updates are correctly rejected.
- [ ] Development and held-out template families stay disjoint.
- [ ] Pending registry assignments are not confused with verified source-group records.
- [ ] Locked primary-test content is stored outside the shared GitHub checkout.
- [ ] No competition text was imported without an approved provenance note.
